environment.description: Same Django REST service on ECS Fargate behind an internal NLB (scheme=internal) in a private subnet (10.128.0.0/20). Ingress controlled by VPC security group sg-0a4f8e2c1b that permits TCP/8000 only from source prefix-list pl-07c4a2d9f (which resolves to 10.200.4.0/22 and 10.200.8.0/23 — the monitoring subnet and the internal API gateway subnet). No internet gateway attached to the VPC route table for the service subnet. Additionally, a Network Firewall stateful rule group 'svc-inventory-access-control' with a Suricata-compatible rule drops any packet to port 8000 not originating from the two permitted CIDR ranges. DNS resolution for the service is only available via Route53 private hosted zone associated with the VPC.

config.network_firewall_rule: drop tcp any any -> $SERVICE_SUBNET 8000 (msg:"unauthorized access"; flow:to_server; NOT src_net 10.200.4.0/22,10.200.8.0/23; sid:1000001; rev:1;)
